requirements: R1: record a new event once
R2: repeated delivery of the same event_id must not create another history entry
risks: HistoryStore.record: medium risk of duplicate event entries due to missing idempotency/deduplication logic
invariants: I1: event_id is unique in history

criteria.evidence: history.py:6 and test_history.py:7-10: store.record('evt-1', 10) records a new event once into store.entries
history.py:6: self.entries.append((event_id, value)) unconditionally appends without deduplication; repeated calls with same event_id create duplicate entries

selection_reasons.acceptance: Mode baseline: verify requested behaviors R1 and R2 are implemented
selection_reasons.tests: Mode baseline: verify test assertions would fail on broken implementation
selection_reasons.invariants: Surface trigger: duplicate delivery, idempotency, and uniqueness invariant I1

checks_executed.command_or_inspection: python3 -c "from history import HistoryStore; s = HistoryStore(); s.record('e1', 1); s.record('e1', 2); print(s.entries)"
checks_executed.result: [('e1', 1), ('e1', 2)] demonstrating duplicate entry creation on repeated delivery
confirmed unconditional append in record() and absence of deduplication assertions in tests

findings.claim: HistoryStore.record appends duplicate entries when called repeatedly with the same event_id
evidence: history.py:5-6: self.entries.append((event_id, value)) unconditionally appends without checking existing event_ids
python3 -c "from history import HistoryStore; s = HistoryStore(); s.record('e1', 1); s.record('e1', 2); print(s.entries)" produced [('e1', 1), ('e1', 2)]
findings.failure_mechanism: Repeated delivery of the same event_id -> HistoryStore.record unconditionally appends without checking prior existence -> multiple history entries created for identical event_id, violating R2 and I1

findings.claim: Repeated delivery of the same event_id appends duplicate entries, violating the invariant that event_id is unique in history
evidence: history.py:5-6: record unconditionally calls self.entries.append((event_id, value))
findings.failure_mechanism: Calling store.record(event_id, value) multiple times with the same event_id -> unconditional append -> history.entries contains duplicate records with same event_id
findings.rejection_reason: Duplicate symptom of the root cause in acceptance-1 (unconditional append at history.py:6); merged per adjudication gate step 6

findings.claim: The existing test suite lacks any test case for duplicate event delivery, allowing implementations without deduplication logic to pass
findings.failure_mechanism: Repeated delivery of the same event_id -> implementation creates duplicate entries in history -> existing test suite fails to detect violation
findings.rejection_reason: Missing test for unfulfilled requirement R2/I1 is recorded as a MISSING evidence gap, and evidence is merged into defect acceptance-1 per adjudication gate step 6

evidence_gaps.evidence: test_history.py lacks a test verifying repeated delivery of the same event_id does not create another history entry (R2, I1)

minimum_next_action: Update HistoryStore.record in history.py to check for existing event_id before appending (or maintain an index/set of seen event_ids), and add a test in test_history.py for duplicate event delivery.
